invariants.rationale: inputRecords will be used and passed to other methods; must not be null by usage.
configuredParallelism is used to deduce targetParallelism for partitioning; non-positive parallelism would not make sense.
instantTime is likely a required identifier for the write operation; it is commonly ensured non-null and non-empty.

partitioner is used to repartition records and get write handle factory; it must be non-null.
